evidence_gaps: Fresh-within-two-hours runtime forensics are unavailable; evidence.json reports MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS.
No reconciled per-trade wallet deltas covering fees, slippage, price impact, gas or priority fees, platform fees and failed-attempt costs.
No chain- and strategy-specific money-weighted net P&L, profit factor, drawdown, tail loss or contribution concentration.
No attempt-level STRATEGY/MARKET versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE classification with UNKNOWN cases retained.
No expected-versus-realised quote deterioration, inclusion failure, RPC failure or reconciliation-mismatch distribution.
No contemporaneous Solana follower-size entry and reverse-exit quote coverage demonstrating sellability and positive executable round-trip edge.
No chronological out-of-sample results across multiple volatility, liquidity and congestion regimes.

Before promotion, require fresh reconciled runtime evidence, cost-complete positive net P&L per chain-specific variant, adequate independent samples, robust out-of-sample partitions, bounded tail loss, reliable sellability/liquidity, and no unresolved execution or reconciliation failures.

proposals.downside_risk: Confirmed samples will accumulate more slowly, and incomplete reconciliation may leave outcomes pending rather than scored.

evidence.detail: BROADCAST is treated as executed evidence even though settlement and realised outcome are not confirmed.
The recorder falls back from realised_net_base to expected_net_base, allowing forecasts to enter realised lifecycle evaluation.
realised_net_base deducts actual cycle gas, while profit_fee_base is recorded separately; the Strategy Lab recorder does not subtract that fee.

proposals.expected_effect: Prevents optimistic promotion signals and produces comparable chain-specific net P&L after gas or priority fees, slippage, impact, platform fees and failed-attempt costs.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 reconciled closed outcomes per chain and strategy across at least three non-overlapping windows, with zero unresolved accounting mismatches.
proposals.rationale: Promotion and replacement decisions must use settled, money-weighted net outcomes after every attributable cost. Expected outcomes and unconfirmed broadcasts are research/execution observations, not realised P&L.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay a fixed ledger containing confirmed successes, reverted transactions, timed-out broadcasts and pending fee settlements. Require lifecycle realised P&L to equal independently reconciled wallet deltas minus all fees exactly; stop and fail on any expected-value fallback, unconfirmed inclusion or unexplained balance difference.

proposals.downside_risk: Incorrect reason mapping could misclassify ambiguous failures; an explicit UNKNOWN category must remain available.

evidence.detail: execution_failures are stored and aggregated but are not used by evaluate_strategy to separate execution quality from market-edge performance.
Rows outside SUCCESS, SUCCESS_FEE_PENDING and BROADCAST are skipped, so rejected, reverted or timed-out attempts do not reach execution_failures.
The monitor recognizes that execution failures require engineering attribution, but the underlying Strategy Lab lifecycle data can omit those failures.

proposals.expected_effect: Avoids replacing potentially valid signals for infrastructure faults while preventing execution leakage from being hidden outside durable net-P&L assessment.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 20 labelled attempts for each observed chain, including at least five failures when available, with manual review of every UNKNOWN classification.
proposals.rationale: A negative settled trade after faithful execution is STRATEGY/MARKET loss. Revert, timeout, stale quote, RPC failure, reconciliation mismatch or abnormal realised-versus-quoted deterioration is EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure. They require different remedies.
proposals.shadow_test: Feed labelled synthetic and retained audit cases for market losses, quote decay, simulation rejection, revert, RPC timeout and reconciliation mismatch. Require exact category agreement and report both signal-conditioned theoretical net and realised all-attempt net; fail if UNKNOWN exceeds 10% or any failed attempt disappears.

proposals.downside_risk: Extra quote requests may consume API capacity, and quote-only outcomes can overestimate fill quality unless later compared with simulations and realised execution.

evidence.detail: Solana leader events intentionally set gross edge, fees, slippage, price impact, latency reserve, liquidity and sellability to zero and mark current edge as unproven.
The common model correctly requires gross edge minus fees, slippage, impact and latency reserve, but current Solana observations cannot populate those inputs.

proposals.expected_effect: Creates falsifiable Solana SHADOW evidence without forcing trades and permits comparison of leader-copy signals against actual follower-size executable economics.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 independently timestamped opportunities across 14 days, at least 30 executable round-trip SHADOW observations, and separate reporting by liquidity and copy-delay regime.
proposals.rationale: Historical leader returns do not prove a follower can enter and exit profitably after copy delay, Jupiter route economics, priority fees and price impact.
proposals.shadow_test: For each eligible leader BUY, record decision-time follower-size entry and reverse-exit quotes, Jupiter/platform and priority fees, impact, slippage reserve and copy-delay reserve. Mark eligible only when conservative round-trip net edge is positive. Stop the hypothesis if quote coverage is below 90%, reverse sellability fails, or reconciled SHADOW outcomes are non-positive after all costs.

proposals.downside_risk: Longer observation periods may delay useful strategies, especially when valid opportunities are rare.

evidence.detail: A promotion candidate can be produced after three windows and eight trades using aggregate net profit and profit factor, without enforced out-of-sample, regime, drawdown or confidence requirements.
Metrics aggregate all selected windows; chain identity and non-overlapping train/validation partitions are not first-class evaluation dimensions.

proposals.expected_effect: Reduces false discovery and ensures each chain-specific variant demonstrates robust money-weighted net performance rather than pooled or in-sample success.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least three non-overlapping validation windows, 30 reconciled outcomes per chain-specific variant, and coverage of at least two volatility/liquidity regimes; otherwise remain SHADOW.
proposals.rationale: Eight observations can be dominated by one outlier, one chain or one transient regime. Solana and EVM have materially different cost and failure distributions and must not cross-subsidise promotion evidence.
proposals.shadow_test: Use chronological walk-forward partitions and report each chain separately. Require positive cost-complete net P&L and profit factor above 1 in every validation partition, no single trade contributing more than 35% of total net, and non-negative results under observed p95 costs. Fail on any validation partition with negative net or unresolved reconciliation.

rejected_ideas.idea: Lower edge, liquidity, sellability or simulation thresholds to increase trade frequency.
rejected_ideas.reason: More trades do not imply durable net profit and would increase exposure to negative executable edge.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote from current architecture-only or quote/simulation evidence.
rejected_ideas.reason: Fresh runtime forensics, settled outcomes and out-of-sample cost-complete results are absent.

rejected_ideas.idea: Pool Solana and EVM performance into one profitability decision.
rejected_ideas.reason: Gas, priority fees, inclusion behavior, liquidity, latency and failure modes are chain-specific.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository generally enforces positive executable edge and chain-specific cost inputs, but Strategy Lab accounting can classify BROADCAST rows using expected rather than realised P&L, omit profit-share cost, and exclude failed executions from lifecycle metrics. These defects can confuse STRATEGY/MARKET loss with EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure and overstate durable money-weighted net performance. Solana SHADOW market features deliberately lack contemporaneous executable edge. With runtime forensics unavailable, no profitability, CANARY-readiness or LIVE-readiness claim is supported.
